The '''2012–13 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach was [[Rick Barnes]], who was in his 15th year. The team played its home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, TX|Austin]], [[Texas]] and were members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. They finished the season 16–18, 7–11 in Big 12 play to finish in seventh place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to Kansas State. Texas received an invitation to the [[2013 College Basketball Invitational]] and became the first Big 12 team to participate in the postseason tournament's six-year history.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://blog.chron.com/cougars/2013/03/cougars-ut-to-meet-in-college-basketball-invitational/|title=Cougars, Longhorns to meet in College Basketball Invitational |publisher=Houston Chronicle |accessdate=2013-03-24}}</ref> The Longhorns lost in the first round to former [[Southwest Conference]] rival [[2012–13 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]].
